request.style: English, folk, warm male solo voice with soft choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, harp, 80 BPM, contemplative and reverent
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Jeshua the line began to flow
Joiakim passed the torch and the robe
Eliashib stood where the altar stood
Joiada served in the holy wood

[Chorus]
Recorded in the house of the fathers
Priests and Levites in ancient places
In the days of Darius the Persian
The names are kept in a holy version

[Verse]
Jonathan walked in the priestly path
And Jaddua kept the sacred oath
But one of the sons sought a foreign wife
Sanballat’s daughter became his life

[Chorus]
Recorded in the house of the fathers
Priests and Levites in ancient places
In the days of Darius the Persian
The names are kept in a holy version

[Bridge]
Nehemiah drove the son away
To keep the covenant clear and bright
The walls were rebuilt the spirit stayed
Serving the Lord with righteous light

[Outro]
Joiada fathered Jonathan
Jonathan fathered Jaddua
The line of Eliashib stands
